name.ja: 固定状態HVPと二階陰関数則の独立参照
name.en: Independent references for fixed-state HVPs and second-order implicit rules

note.ja: 解析解 4変数のdyadic二次関数とサイズ7/31の固定Bratu energyを用います。別の正枝陰関数u²−θ=0はθ=4、初期値u=3から解き、状態固定偏微分と全微分を分けます。 一般のreduced inverse Hessianや有限Newton traceの数学的陰関数微分とは主張しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Use a four-variable dyadic quadratic and fixed-state Bratu energies of sizes 7 and 31. A separate positive implicit branch u²-theta=0 is solved at theta 4 from initial u 3, distinguishing fixed-state partials from total derivatives. No general reduced inverse Hessian or identification of finite Newton traces with implicit derivatives.

name.ja: 非滑らかな離散写像：一方向微分と実行trace
name.en: Nonsmooth discrete maps: directional derivatives and executed traces

note.ja: 解析解 abs・ReLU・clip・多項式分岐の固定7点と方向±1を用います。停止反復はx0=0、更新前に|xk−θ|≤1/8を検査し最大5更新。θ=1/4,1/2,1は切替点です。 選択した分岐の微分は普遍的なsubgradientや非滑らかな写像の線形微分ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Use seven fixed points and directions ±1 for abs, ReLU, clip and a polynomial branch. The stopped iteration starts at x0 = 0, tests |xk - theta| <= 1/8 before updating and allows at mostfive updates. Theta 1/4, 1/2 and 1 are switching points. An executed-branch derivative is not a universal subgradient or a linear derivative of a nonsmooth map.
